name: com.theylovedit/gifts
title: They Loved It gift catalog
description: Search a hand-picked gift catalog by recipient, interest and budget, and build gift lists.

tools.name: search_gifts
tools.description: Use this when someone wants gift ideas for a person, for example "a gift for my dad who grills, under $50" or "stocking stuffers for a 10 year old". Filters a hand-picked catalog by recipient, interests, budget, age and attributes, and returns ranked products with who each suits, who should skip it, a price band and a link. Give at least one filter. Do not use it for buying, price tracking or order status.

for.description: Who the gift is for, e.g. dad, mom, partner, sister, friend, teen, kid, coworker. Comma-separate several. Everyday words like wife or grandma work too.

interests.description: Interests, e.g. grilling, coffee, reading, outdoors, gaming. Any match counts; more matches rank higher.

age.description: Age of a child recipient, used to respect age ranges.

attributes.description: Required qualities, e.g. stocking-stuffer, last-minute, practical, consumable, experience, made-in-usa, small-business, splurge.

q.description: Free-text words to match, e.g. "thermometer" or "cast iron".

offset.description: Skip this many results, for paging.

tools.name: build_gift_list
tools.description: Use this when someone is shopping for several people at once, for example "ideas for my mom, my brother who games and a coworker, about $30 each". Give each recipient a label and filters; returns a short list per person with no product repeated across people.

recipients.description: One entry per person on the list.

label.description: A name for this person, e.g. "Uncle Joe".

for.description: Who the gift is for, e.g. dad, mom, partner, sister, friend, teen, kid, coworker. Comma-separate several. Everyday words like wife or grandma work too.

interests.description: Interests, e.g. grilling, coffee, reading, outdoors, gaming. Any match counts; more matches rank higher.

age.description: Age of a child recipient, used to respect age ranges.

attributes.description: Required qualities, e.g. stocking-stuffer, last-minute, practical, consumable, experience, made-in-usa, small-business, splurge.

q.description: Free-text words to match, e.g. "thermometer" or "cast iron".

per_person.description: How many ideas to return for each person.

tools.name: get_gift
tools.description: Use this to get the full details of one product from an earlier search_gifts or build_gift_list result, by its id.

id.description: The product id from a search result, e.g. "47-clean-up-adjustable-team-cap".

tools.name: list_tags
tools.description: Use this to see which recipients, interests, budgets and attributes search_gifts understands, with how many products carry each. Call it when a search returns unknown_terms.
